title: Projection is invariant under replacing the projected coordinate
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $i$ be a coordinate, let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $x\in\Omega^n$ and $\omega\in\Omega$. The projection of $f$ onto all coordinates except $i$ has the same value at $x$ and at the point obtained by replacing coordinate $i$ of $x$ with $\omega$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
